products.description_original:
Featuring a compound aerodynamic layout that combines a quad-rotor configuration with a fixed wing, it integrates the vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) capability of rotorcraft with the long-endurance advantages of fixed-wing aircraft. Highly maneuverable and flexible, it adapts to a wide range of complex take-off and landing conditions. Powered by a hybrid gasoline-electric propulsion system, it delivers an endurance of over 10 hours, and is widely applied in defense surveillance, emergency communications and other fields.

Excellent Waterproof Performance: The whole aircraft features a waterproof design, ensuring reliable flight under complex weather conditions.
Hybrid Gasoline-Electric Propulsion: Integrated hybrid power delivers an endurance of over 10 hours.
Modular Design: Tool-free disassembly across the entire aircraft enables rapid installation within 3 minutes.

products.description_original:
The WP-4000 is a fuel-injected, air-cooled, two-stroke, horizontally opposed two-cylinder gasoline aircraft piston engine. Its compact, lightweight design delivers high reliability, low cost, easy maintenance, and excellent performance, making it ideal for fixed-wing and compound-wing UAVs.

Features:
1. Electronic fuel injection; redundant spark plugs and speed sensor.
2. Real-time monitoring of barometric pressure, air temperature, cylinder head temperature, and exhaust gas temperature.
3. Over-temperature and over-speed protection with control logic.
4. Constant speed control.
5. Adaptive control over a wide temperature range (-35°C ~ +65°C).
6. Ambient temperature and barometric pressure compensation.
7. ECU-to-host communication via RS232/CAN.
8. Rear drive shaft output, counterclockwise rotation (viewed from propeller side).
9. Synchronized two-cylinder ignition; ECU-controlled inductive discharge four-spark plug ignition.
